title: Gấp, ngay: asking for urgent help

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say grandfather, or an older man —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ông] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say grandmother, or an older woman —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: bà] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say aunt, or Miss —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: cô] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say uncle, a youngish man —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chú] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say uncle or aunt, older than your parents —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: bác] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say child —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: con] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Tôi cần gấp, gọi cảnh sát giúp tôi!] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Dạ, tôi đi ngay.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Cảm ơn chị, nguy hiểm quá.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Dạ, chờ một chút nha.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Two new words today: asking for urgent help.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: First,] [VI: gấp] [EN: means urgent. It has] [VI: dấu sắc] [EN: . Listen again.] [VI_F: gấp] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: gấp] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: gấp] [EN: Good. I need it urgently —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi cần gấp.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next,] [VI: ngay] [EN: means right away, immediately. It has] [VI: ngang] [EN: — flat. Listen again.] [VI_F: ngay] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: ngay] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ngay] [EN: Good. I'll go right away —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi đi ngay.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Combine them — so urgent, go right away —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Gấp quá, đi ngay!]

[EN: Quick pass over today's words.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Urgent —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: gấp] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Right away, immediately —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ngay] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: I need it urgently —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi cần gấp.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Let's drill. Urgent —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: gấp] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Right away, immediately —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ngay] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now build it.
